explanation: God who dwells within believing Christians and guides them toward righteousness and life, in contrast to the flesh.
Humanity's weak, sinful nature that is subject to death and cannot fulfill God's law.
A spiritual principle or set of rules; here specifically the law of the Spirit that brings freedom from the power of death.
The state believers have received through Christ where they are no longer bound by the condemnation of sin, but live in God's grace.
The concept of God taking Christians in as his own children with all the rights and inheritance that entails.
The Spirit who cares for human weakness and intercedes on their behalf when they do not know what to pray for.
God's eternal plan in which he chose people to be conformed to the image of his Son before the foundation of the world was laid.
The term for God's invitation and power that draws people to Himself, ensuring they reach their ultimate goal.
A confident expectation of the future based on God's promises, even when it is not yet seen with one's own eyes.
